payload.title: Translation spend learned from runs
payload.description:
As a publication operator, I want translation spend predicted, shown and never silent, so a language never costs more than I can see coming.

Design: section 3.7. Three learned controls, no fixed caps: a site translations budget per rolling week (decision 11 of the plan), a per-run cost prediction learned from measured cost per source token per language, and a polish loop that ends on convergence rather than a count. Spanish and Chinese distributions are kept separately.

```gherkin
Feature: Translation spend is predicted, shown and never silent
  Scenario: A run far above its prediction is held, not cut off
    Given past Chinese runs cost a steady amount per thousand source words
    When a run costs several times its prediction
    Then it finishes its round and holds with the reason
    And the run appears in the automations history marked as an outlier

  Scenario: The weekly budget pauses new runs in the open
    Given the site's translations budget for the week is reached
    When an English Story is published
    Then the Chinese run waits
    And the console shows the backlog and the amount

  Scenario: Spend is learned per language
    Given Spanish and Chinese runs have different costs per source word
    When the next run of each language is predicted
    Then each prediction uses only that language's measured runs
```
